value.rationale: \(G_L\) was introduced to quantify equilateral-triangle geometry and exact values on concrete spaces are a stated target of the defining literature. The regular octagon is a canonical non-Hilbertian Minkowski plane used in later exact equilateral-triangle studies. The result gives a closed-form benchmark strictly between the Hilbert value \(6\) and \(\ell_\infty\) value \(8\) and supplies a reusable exact polyhedral optimization. The limitation is that it is a concrete-space theorem rather than a classification.
